title: COMBAT SOUND VOICE CAPS
why: Q27: stutter or harsh sound in a two player fight. Cap complete cues at 6 guns, 8 impacts, 3 explosions and 12 active combat voices per window. Replace the oldest cue first with a 4 ms fade and stop all its sources, including delayed pumps and tails. At most two retiring fades can overlap the active budget. An isolated shot retains every original layer, pitch, timing and level. Playtest watch: both windows firing the LMG and shotgun near metal impacts and explosions should stay clear; listen for clicks, lost nearby shots or missing shotgun pumps under pressure.
now: Gunfire, impacts and explosions have bounded overlap; oldest sounds yield during heavy fights.
